name: Beacon Flare
summary: A flare that rises into the sky and glows as a signal for an hour.
description: Used by caravans and shepherds to send for help. It smells of struck flint.

stats.effect: As a Bonus Action, you can launch this flare into the air. It rises 200 feet and sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius for 1 hour. The flare is visible for 10 miles under open sky and is consumed.
